correctness.rationale: Affine normalization gives a disk and a reciprocal-axis scaled ellipse. Exact polar integration proves the piecewise area. The contact threshold comes from the largest reciprocal singular semiaxis; differentiating the crossing integral gives monotonicity. Symmetric angle preimages prove the unique atom and inverse CDF. A uniform local Taylor expansion of the tangential cap gives the K exponent, and the interval measure converts 3/2 to 2/3. 248 numerical direct-polar comparisons corroborated these assertions.
